reviewed_safety_checks.evidence: getattr(os, pidfd_open, None) plus callable predicate selects bounded /proc fallback; no unconditional attribute reference remains

30-second monotonic deadline, 0.25-second polling; missing /proc or Z/X state returns success; nonempty cmdline must contain both run_scene_gn11.py and scene0008_spec.json; timeout/identity mismatch raises before model stages; no kill in helper
--attempt int choices 1..9, default1 preserved, attempt2 uses distinct metadata/red_masks_20261013_attempt2, mkdir(exist_ok=False) forbids metadata reuse, stage logs use xb

flock LOCK_EX precedes second input validation, complete/iteration30000 checks, actual completion_contract, owned-exit helper, empty compute-apps check, and sky/DEVA launch; lock FD is inherited by each stage subprocess
validate_inputs rejects any existing sky PNG or mask/mask_0 path both before queue startup and after acquiring lock; errors preserve existing assets/logs; no cleanup/deletion or forced resumption
default invocation only validates and prints proof, with no queue mkdir or GPU stage; contracts are stdlib; no actor selection or training launch is implemented
registry attempt must be exactly int (bool excluded), range1..9; suffix constructed from integer rather than using external path

findings.title: Historical attempts disappear until active status exists
findings.trigger: metadata/red_masks_active_queue.json selects attempt2 while attempt2/status.json has not been created or initialization failed before META creation; attempt1/status.json still exists
findings.actual: red_GPU_mask_attempts is assigned only within if mask_queue, so inspector exits normally while omitting old preserved attempt evidence
findings.impact: Launch/initialization failure and brief launch windows lose historical status visibility. This does not weaken GPU startup guards or modify assets.
findings.fix: Compute red_GPU_mask_attempts outside if mask_queue, so all existing attempt statuses remain visible independently of active status availability.

resolution.historical_attempts: red_GPU_mask_attempts aggregation is now outside if mask_queue
resolution.active_status_missing: elif active_queue emits dispatch_pending_runtime_status plus registry pid/log and owned controller process check
resolution.verification: current source inspected only; no additional fixture or runtime invocation

limitations: No remote or live queue execution was performed by this reviewer. Parent has reported actual target CPU helper/default-validation PASS and completed sky-stage returncode0; these were not independently rerun by this reviewer.

Callable pidfd_open on a Python/kernel combination that raises OSError(ENOSYS/EPERM) still fails closed instead of falling back. This is outside the demonstrated missing-attribute environment and is not a deployed blocking finding.

Critical controller predicates use assert, so launcher must retain PYTHONOPTIMIZE=0 and avoid python -O; the earlier owned launcher already does so, and the new attempt2 launcher was not available in this review.
Sky/DEVA output validity, runtime memory, actor identity, training readiness, checkpoint loading, and restoration remain uncertified.
